Maria Chen: Quick async check — doing a compact ship audit for the quarter. Please drop 1-line items for: what shipped, what slipped, owner, and next step. Keep it short. @Aj @Kevin FYI.

Aj Patel: Shipped: routing policy UI + canary flag. Owner: Aj. Next: docs + rollout checklist. :white_check_mark:

Kevin Wong: Slipped: model quantization rollout. Owner: Kevin. Blocker: perf regressions on long sequences. Next: triage perf traces & revert risky kernel.

Sasha Ivanova: Shipped: eval harness for reranking. Owner: Sasha. Next: add regression alerts to Optimize.

Kai Morris: Slipped: Dedicated autoscale policy integration. Owner: Kai. Blocker: infra quota + infra-oncall bandwidth. Next: temporary manual scaling + ops ticket.

Maria Chen: Noted. Can owners add a 1-sentence risk and ETA by EOD? helps product prioritization.

Kevin Wong: Risk: if we don't fix perf by next week we'll delay client rollout. ETA: WIP — aiming for 5 business days.

Aj Patel: Risk: minimal. ETA: docs + rollout by Wed.

Sasha Ivanova: ETA: 2 business days for alerts. No blocker.

Kai Morris: ETA: 3 business days to add manual scaling and open quota request. Ops pinged.

Maria Chen: Thanks — product will re-evaluate milestone statuses tomorrow morning. If any owner needs headcount help, shout now.

Kevin Wong: Might need a short GPU run from eng-infra to repro perf on longer sequences. @deploy-bot can you schedule a 2h slot on g4-16 for next Tue?

deploy-bot: Scheduled test window: `g4-16` reserved Tue 09:00–11:00 UTC. Reservation ID: rsv-8742.

Aj Patel: One more ask — plz add the final release tags here when rolled: format `release/<model>-vX.Y.Z`. I'll update the milestone board.

Sasha Ivanova: Will do for rerank: `release/rerank-v1.2.0` once alerts are verified.

Kai Morris: Adding manual scaling playbook link: https://intra.redwood/ops/manual-autoscale (short summary added).

Maria Chen: Great. I'll summarize for the exec status note: shipped = routing UI, eval harness; slipped = quantization, autoscale integration; actions = perf triage, manual scaling, alerts + docs. Thanks everyone — ping here when ETAs change. :rocket:
